text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day, meaning Shinko<n>Windy has
officially entered her<n>classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's still technically<n>winter vacation, I
stop by my office to<n>check on a few things, only to
find...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyah?! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Didn't think you'd be here so soon...<n>Doesn't
matter though... Heehee...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A-hem, so, ummm...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I just got here a second ago,<n>and then you
arrive! Wh-what a<n>coincidence, am I right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to play along... when I<n>suddenly realize...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's one, two... three whole<n>objects that I've
never seen before<n>placed in my office!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh! Lookie here! What could these<n>be?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! A treasure map! Lucky<n>us—looks like riches
are just a short<n>run away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And what's that big box sitting on<n>your desk?!
There's gotta be lots of<n>yummy New Year's grub
inside!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And... can you believe it?! There's a<n>gift envelope
here with "One Million<n>Yen" written on it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Somebody must've left you presents.<n>It'd be rude
not to pick one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...They're all traps, for sure. I can tell<n>from Shinko
Windy's expectant<n>smile.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Lackey! What'll it be?
choice_data_list: Run to the "X" on the treasure map!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's your choice, huh? All right,<n>then whatcha
waitin' for?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hurry, hurry! To that tree!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a spot in that direction where<n>the color of
the grass doesn't look<n>right... This has got to be it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SLIP! Fwoosh... Thud!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... BWAHAHAHA! You fell<n>right into my trap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This hole is lined with cushions.<n>What's more, it's
deep enough to put<n>a TV prank show to shame.
Talk<n>about exceeding expectations!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Weeell?! Whaddya think about my<n>super awesome
pitfall trap?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're never gonna climb outta there<n>alone!
Mwahaha! Go on, let me hear<n>you cry for help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It couldn't have been easy digging<n>this hole. I grin
thinking of how much<n>exercise she must've gotten
for her<n>legs and back.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! MWAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Not yet! First, I gotta bury you with all<n>these leaves!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Eventually, she lowers a rope ladder<n>with a
satisfied smirk on her face.<n>I'm glad she had a
good time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're hungry, huh? Nice choice.<n>Well, c'mon. Open
the box.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the lid, and... something jumps<n>out at me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! It's a jack-in-the-box!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Trainer? Can't<n>handle a little
jump scare?<n>Teeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's another compartment in the<n>box, though.
Betcha something real<n>tasty's inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What'll jump out at me this time? I<n>cautiously open
the second layer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's filled with New Year's dishes that<n>look
amazingly delicious. Black<n>beans, herring roe, fish
cake, rolled<n>shrimp, and so much more...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's what I call a meal! ♪<n>C'mon, Trainer!
Dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if it's laced with hot sauce?<n>Ready for the
worst, I drip some soy<n>sauce on a fish cake and
take a bite...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure looks like a fish cake, eh? But...<n>surprise! It's
a gummy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon closer inspection, the other<n>foods in the box
are also made of<n>marzipan and jelly. I stick my
chopstick into one only to find it's<n>sponge cake
with cream inside.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well? Everything looks just like the<n>real deal,
doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it awesome?! I snatched 'em all<n>off the
internet!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They also had phony ramen, phony<n>gyoza... even
phony pork cutlets and<n>sushi!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But I gotta say, you looked so stupid<n>putting soy
sauce on a gummy!<n>Heheheh... bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, what a riot. Welp, now that the<n>cat's outta
the bag...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'mma dig in, too! Trainer! Fetch me<n>some juice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nom... Nom... Yum! Doesn't look it, butit's real cake!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Goin' for the money, eh? Who the<n>heck wouldn't?
Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A million yen would never fit in a<n>envelope this
small... But I pretend I<n>don't know that and open it
up to<n>find...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! If only you could see your<n>face!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A horrendous smell leaks out of the<n>envelope.
Peering inside, I find a<n>sheet of cotton wool soaked
in a dark<n>liquid I can only assume is made from
chameleon plant leaves.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heeheehee! Chameleon plants grow<n>like weeds in
the academy's garden!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I pulled a whole mess of 'em, tore<n>'em up, ground
'em down, and made<n>'em into sludge!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Getta load of that stink! Did I<n>ruin your
peaceful New Year holiday<n>or what?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So much for taking it slow and<n>easy this
morning. Chameleon plant<n>leaves are used in plenty
of<n>medicines, so it's probably good for<n>your health.
But still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second. Doing this means she<n>must've
voluntarily weeded the<n>academy garden.
choice_data_list: You've turned over a new leaf!
You've turned over a new leaf!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why does it sound like you're<n>proud of me?! I
just pranked you,<n>you know?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uuurgh! Now I'm ticked!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! That'll set ya straight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's in a good mood after<n>her
successful prank, we exchange<n>New Years'
greetings.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Right back at'cha.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I got to start this year off with a good<n>prank, too...
Heh-heh! A masterpiece,<n>even!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I gotta keep this up! Nobody's safe<n>from Wicked
Windy this year!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... No way I'd do that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' back, last year went pretty<n>well, if I do say
so myself.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But this year, there's gonna be noholdin' back. You best be ready tokeep up with me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: With my fanbase already gettingbigger, I gotta keep the ball rolling andsteal all the attention!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about<n>Shinko Windy's
legs becoming<n>inflamed anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now's a good time to turn things up a<n>notch so can
she aim for tougher<n>races. This year is already
looking<n>bright for the two of us.
